 High Court Of Andhra Pradesh At Amaravati

sentences.text:
Main Case No: W.P.No.33764 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
No. Date Order

NOTE 01. 05.12.2025 HN, J  The learned counsel for the petitioners  submits that the petitioners are the joint  owners and possessors of the land  admeasuring Ac.0.21 cents in Sy. No. 95/2 of  Cherlopalli Revenue Village, C.K. Dinne  Mandal, Kadapa District, having purchased  the same vide a registered sale deed dated  18.08.2011.
It is submitted that the property was  initially given Ryotwari Patta in favour of one  Sri Gorla Gurrappa on 03.10.1934 and title  deed No.76 was issued to G. Gurrappa.
It is also submitted that thereafter  several transactions took place and ultimately  the property was purchased by the  petitioners.

It is submitted that out of Ac.0.31  cents of land in the said survey number,
 Ac.0.10 cents was acquired by the State and  the Land Acquisition Officer had granted  compensation to the then owner,
 Y. Subhadramma, in the year 2007.

It is submitted that the property of the  petitioners was included in the register  maintained under Section 43 of the Andhra  Contd..
 Pradesh Charitable and Hindu Religious  SL. OFFICE No. DATE ORDER NOTE  Institutions and Endowments Act, 1987 by the  4th respondent.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are lawful purchasers of the property and have interest over the same, and as such place reliance on Section 6(c)(ii), Sections 43 and 44 of the Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted that the petitioners have to be considered as persons having interest as defined under the Act and notice ought to have been issued to the petitioners before deciding to include the land of the petitioners in the register maintained under Section 43 of the Act.

The learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondent(s) submits that the petitioners ought to have approached the Tribunal instead of approaching this Court and submits that the property Unknown vs 5.12.2025 Hn on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59650689/
1 would be included in the register only after conducting a due enquiry.
Be that as it may, counters are to be filed by the respondents.
There shall be an interim direction as prayed for.
